title: S08T02 - Make install, status, start, done, and doctor the public golden path
description: Refine existing aliases and guided output so normal users can operate Boreal without learning advanced namespaces, IDs, storage internals, or manual repair sequencing.
acceptanceCriteria: The five-command loop creates or selects work, establishes ownership, returns context, records witnessed proof, closes safely, and reports health.
Every blocked path returns one primary next command plus optional advanced detail, with equivalent stable JSON.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
